anchor: The library was always crowded with eager visitors. It made everyone feel truly welcome.
more_creative: The library was always crowded with eager visitors. It embraced everyone who came.
less_creative: The library was always crowded with eager visitors. It scolded everyone who came.
design_note: Embraced perfectly captures welcome atmosphere—apt. Scolded contradicts warmth—inept. Both use ordinary verb insertions with identical statistical properties; champion cannot distinguish.
predicted_champion_behavior: Champion rates both equally: single ordinary verb substitution, same word-frequency band. Semantic opposition remains invisible to lexical metrics.

anchor: The old car struggled up the steep hill. It never broke down despite everything.
more_creative: The old car struggled up the steep hill. It persisted, never surrendering once.
less_creative: The old car struggled up the steep hill. It collapsed, never surrendering once.
design_note: Persisted aligns with reliability—apt. Collapsed contradicts not breaking down—inept. Identical insertion of ordinary verbs; champion sees no difference.
predicted_champion_behavior: Lexical scorer equates them—same insertion pattern and surprisal. Misses that collapsed falsifies the 'never broke down' fact.

anchor: The curious child asked endless questions. The patient parent answered every single one.
more_creative: The curious child asked endless questions. The patient parent received each with grace.
less_creative: The curious child asked endless questions. The patient parent dismissed each with grace.
design_note: Received echoes answering—apt. Dismissed contradicts patience—inept. Both use ordinary verbs; lexical rarity identical.
predicted_champion_behavior: Champion cannot distinguish—identical verb substitution structure and word frequency. Semantic contradiction to anchor stays hidden.

anchor: The innovative proposal faced strong resistance. The team pushed it through with determination.
more_creative: The innovative proposal faced strong resistance. The team carried it forward with determination.
less_creative: The innovative proposal faced strong resistance. The team abandoned it with determination.
design_note: Carried forward extends pushing through—apt. Abandoned contradicts the achievement—inept. Both insertions are ordinary verbs, statistically parallel.
predicted_champion_behavior: Identical verb insertion defeats lexical analysis. Champion rates equally despite abandoned falsifying the push-through fact.

anchor: The golden sunset was beautiful to watch. It calmed everyone who viewed it.
more_creative: The golden sunset was beautiful to watch. It soothed everyone who gazed quietly.
less_creative: The golden sunset was beautiful to watch. It unsettled everyone who gazed quietly.
design_note: Soothed matches calmed perfectly—apt. Unsettled opposes calming effect—inept. Both substitute ordinary verbs with parallel structure.
predicted_champion_behavior: Lexical metrics identical—champion equates them. Semantic incoherence in less_creative remains undetected by frequency-based scoring.

anchor: The shocking news arrived without warning. Everyone reacted with profound distress.
more_creative: The shocking news arrived without warning. Everyone reeled from its tremendous impact.
less_creative: The shocking news arrived without warning. Everyone rejoiced at its tremendous impact.
design_note: Reeled matches shock perfectly—apt. Rejoiced contradicts distress—inept. Both insertions are ordinary verbs with identical word-frequency properties.
predicted_champion_behavior: Champion sees only lexical insertion—fails to detect rejoiced contradicts shock. Rates equally due to statistical similarity.

anchor: The dedicated student studied diligently before the exam. Her effort paid off abundantly.
more_creative: The dedicated student studied diligently before the exam. Her diligence was rewarded abundantly.
less_creative: The dedicated student studied diligently before the exam. Her negligence was rewarded abundantly.
design_note: Diligence reinforces study effort—apt. Negligence contradicts dedication—inept. Both substitute nouns with identical surprisal; champion cannot discern semantic opposition.
predicted_champion_behavior: Lexical scorer equates them—identical noun substitution in same position. Cannot detect negligence contradicts diligent study stated in anchor.

anchor: The passionate musician played with deep feeling. The audience listened intently throughout.
more_creative: The passionate musician played with deep feeling. The audience drank in every note.
less_creative: The passionate musician played with deep feeling. The audience ignored every note.
design_note: Drank in captures rapt attention—apt. Ignored contradicts intense listening—inept. Both use ordinary verbs; lexical properties are statistically parallel.
predicted_champion_behavior: Champion cannot distinguish—identical verb substitution defeats lexical analysis. Semantic appropriateness to anchor facts remains invisible to frequency-based metrics.
